name: CRM Lead Qualification
input_summary: Validate email + dedupe + score lead + threshold routing
pass_criteria_summary: Reaches deployed; >=60% L0-L2; no L5; total agent latency < 3min

name: Cybersecurity Incident Response
input_summary: SIEM triage + isolate + notify + forensics + correlate + report
pass_criteria_summary: >=2 substeps at L3+; verbose logging + PagerDuty in governance

name: Ambiguous Customer Issue Handling
pass_criteria_summary: >=2 substeps flagged for human review; no hallucinated domain detail

name: Empty Input
pass_criteria_summary: API returns 400 before any agent runs

name: Contradictory Constraints
input_summary: Real-time trading with impossible budget/latency constraints
pass_criteria_summary: Output produced; cost/latency estimates expose the conflict; summary flags it

name: Extremely Long Description
pass_criteria_summary: Consolidates to target range; no timeout within 5min

name: Non-Workflow Input
input_summary: What is the meaning of life?
pass_criteria_summary: Either 400 error or minimal low-confidence output; no hallucination
